title: Enforce revoke-first Company B recovery
objective: Starting only from the clean B-TASK-003 result, make queue-state.json a fail-closed publication-recovery capability: whenever a candidate becomes non-recoverable, revoke the local queue-state file before any fallible GitHub lifecycle/comment operation. Preserve the file only for explicitly recoverable publication failures. Do not copy or salvage B-TASK-006 worktree changes.
acceptance_criteria: Treat existence of the per-Issue queue-state.json as recovery eligibility; do not introduce a second eligibility flag.

For CLOSED Issue, invalid local queue state, WORKER_FAILED, WORKER_NOT_PASS, EVIDENCE_INVALID, worker-state validation failure, task-spec validation failure, task/branch mismatch, and PUBLISHED completion revalidation failure: remove queue-state.json before attempting any GitHub label/comment status publication.

If the subsequent GitHub blocked/status publication fails after local revocation, queue-state.json must remain absent and the Issue must not be eligible for publication recovery on the next invocation.
Retain queue-state.json only for a validated PASS/DONE worker result whose failure is limited to recoverable remote publication/completion work.
Recovery from a retained state must revalidate same task/branch, worker PASS/DONE/review PASS, fixed-test PASS, Codex PASS evidence, Draft PR/exact-head conditions as appropriate before continuing.
A PUBLISHED completion-only recovery must revoke local recovery eligibility if its saved PR/head/evidence marker cannot be revalidated; it must not retry forever as a valid recovery candidate.
Publication-only recovery must never invoke company-b-worker.ps1, Claude implementation, or Codex review again.
Queued Issues with an existing runtime but without a valid retained recovery transaction must fail closed.
Set the queue wrapper default BaseRef to company-b/operational-v0.1.
Keep the implementation minimal: modify existing recovery/lifecycle flow rather than broadly rewriting the queue worker.
Replace brittle fixed-character-window assertions with structural assertions that inspect the relevant branch/function body without depending on comments or exact character distance.

Regression tests must cover revoke-before-GitHub ordering for each non-recoverable class, validation exceptions, PUBLISHED revalidation failure, retained PUBLISH_FAILED recovery, no worker reinvocation, and operational BaseRef.
Do not modify documentation, scheduler, heartbeat, authoritative company-b-worker.ps1, Company A files, or trading code.
Final independent Codex review must return PASS.
